data.description:
Board request via DM (chat msg 59, human:forrest): "I think we need query string to keep page context in here. also, the lattice events should link to the lattice site" — this task is the first half (query-string page context); the dashboard-link half is tracked separately.

Problem: apps/chat/public/app.js keeps all selection state (current channel/DM, open thread) in memory only. A refresh drops the user back to 'Select a conversation', and there is no way to share a link that opens a specific channel, DM, or thread.

Scope: encode page context in the URL query string (e.g. ?conv=...&thread=...) — update it on selection (history.replaceState/pushState, no full navigations), restore it on load after identities/conversations arrive, and reconcile with the existing location.hash msg-anchor behavior in openThread/closeThread (fold it in or keep it compatible; planner's call). Constraint: identity must NOT go in the URL — 'me' stays in localStorage ('chat.me'); a shared link must never switch the viewer's identity. Unknown/stale params fail soft to the current default view. Key file: apps/chat/public/app.js (init, selectConversation, openThread, closeThread); no server changes expected.
data.title: Chat: query-string URL state — current channel/DM/thread survives refresh, links shareable

data.body: Planning done (plan: plans/task_01M18DN3DSV2E67REAANDMJ98T.md). Grammar: ?c=<channel-name>|dm:<conv-id> & t=<thread-root-msg-id> & m=<msg-anchor> — identity never in the URL. Core call: URL params resolve ONLY against the viewer's visibility-filtered /api/conversations list; no request is ever issued from an unresolved param, so hidden/nonexistent/forbidden all fail soft through one identical path — parity by construction, no new oracle. History: pushState on user navigation (conv select, thread open/close), replaceState for normalization/identity switch, popstate handled, poll never writes; vestigial location.hash removed. Parsing/serialization is a new pure ESM module public/url-state.js (node:test unit-tested); history/DOM behavior is manual QA (13 walkable criteria in plan; no browser harness). One deviation on record: server.js needs a one-line STATIC_FILES entry for the new module. AS-10 coordination in plan: c/t/m namespace reserved, foreign params preserved, README documents the deep-link contract, AS-10 rebases on this.

Implementation done on feat/AS-9-url-state (a1aa4d4, 04c0271, 5408f02). Built: pure ESM public/url-state.js (parseChatUrl/serializeChatUrl/resolveConversation, foreign params preserved); app.js as module with a single syncUrl funnel (push on user nav, replace for normalize/identity-switch, no-op-if-equal, poll never writes), init restore after identities+list, popstate handler, one fail-soft path with the plan's neutral note, vestigial location.hash writes deleted; m= anchor SHIPPED (one-shot scroll + CSS fade, .anchored); one sanctioned server.js STATIC_FILES entry. Restore reuses selectConversation, so mark-read-on-view is unchanged. Tested: in-container suite 52/52 green (44 pre-existing + 7 url-state unit + 1 static-routing test); oracle contract is an executable test (hidden channel resolves deepEqual to never-existed). Boring choices made where the plan left room: (1) any URL with c/t/m present that fails to restore takes the ONE fail-soft path incl. the note — even bare ?t=5 (single code path beats per-cause messaging); (2) sendMessage's re-render passes url:'none' (posting is not navigation, matches the plan's write inventory); (3) restore wraps selectConversation in try/catch so a conversation that vanishes between list and fetch fails soft instead of killing init. QA should attack: AC 1-13 by hand against compose (history semantics, refresh restore, Priya no-probe check in devtools network, back/forward after 3+ polls, m= one-shot under the 5s poll) — none of those are reachable from node:test. Grep check per plan: location./history. in app.js appears only in syncUrl and restoreFromUrl.
